== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Kelthryss is a northern ivory feathered drake and a dragon-turtle who serves as a companion to [[Carmine]]. She is a formidable combatant capable of spitting sparks and engaging in battle alongside others. As a survivor of a monster attack that [[Carmine]] also escaped, she maintains a protective bond with her owner, often using her wings and tail to shield him. Kelthryss is characterized by her readiness for conflict, though it is suggested she possesses a nature that would prefer living for a purpose rather than merely fighting.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Kelthryss is a feathered drake originating from the north. This creature is characterized by its ivory-colored feathers.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This drake acts as a protector for [[Carmine]]. It travels alongside both [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] and [[Carmine]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The drake is capable of snarling and spitting sparks.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Kelthryss is a northern ivory feathered drake that travels alongside [[Carmine]] and [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]. As a protector of [[Carmine]], this creature is known to snarl and spit sparks during its journeys.}}
